standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the first equality g_! = h_! f_!: its hypotheses (upper morphism separated and locally of finite type, composite locally quasi-finite) are met since h is proper.

standard_prerequisites.name: Proper lower shriek identification (Lemma lemma-proper-f-shriek, canonical tag 0F51)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the second equality h_! = h_* for the proper morphism h.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing for sheaves supported in closed points (Etale Cohomology, Lemma etale-cohomology-lemma-supported-in-closed-points, canonical tag 0F1F)
standard_prerequisites.use: The terminal vanishing: cohomology of a sheaf supported on the closed points of the proper fibre vanishes in positive degrees.

core_obligations: Construct the map: represent K by a complex, resolve f_! of it by a K-injective complex on Y, and define the map through the chain g_!K = h_!f_!K = h_*f_!K followed by h_* of the resolution, the two equalities from the composition lemma and the proper shriek identification (proof lines 3204-3219).

Set up the torsion case: work locally on Z so the fibres of h have bounded dimension, and combine with the finite cohomological dimension of Rh_* to reduce invertibility to the vanishing of R^qh_*(f_!F) for q > 0 and every sheaf F (proof lines 3222-3233).

Prove the vanishing: the stalks of f_!F are nonzero only over points with finite residue field extension by the stalk lemma and local quasi-finiteness of f and g; apply the proper base change theorem to pass to the geometric fibre, where the sheaf is supported on closed points, and conclude by the supported-in-closed-points vanishing (proof lines 3236-3248).

Cover case (a): the bounded-below torsion cohomology case follows by the same argument as in the proof of lemma-shriek-proper-and-open, using the stalk lemma for locally quasi-finite lower shriek in place of the separated colimit lemma (proof lines 3251-3254).
proof_roadmap: Construction of the canonical map on K-injective representatives (proof lines 3204-3219).
Torsion case: local reduction and cohomological dimension (proof lines 3222-3233).
Stalk vanishing on the fibres (proof lines 3236-3248).
Bounded-below case by the parallel argument (proof lines 3251-3254).
